svg.title: Built from scratch: NNUE chess engine: Self-trained, with a custom C inference backend on bare-metal Raspberry Pi graphics.; ARMv8-A emulator: AArch64 decoding, execution and an assembler. Scored 100%.; PintOS kernel: Scheduling, synchronisation, virtual memory, syscalls and file systems.; WACC compiler: Type checking, IRs, optimisations and native code generation.
